sources.title: Open-Sourcing hamo-score-0.6b: Psychological State Scoring That Runs on ...
sources.snippet: Hamo has open-sourced hamo-score-.6b: a 600-million-parameter model that reads one message in a wellness conversation and returns five psychological state dimensions — and never writes a reply. It runs on a laptop in under a second, agrees with a frontier cloud scorer on 96.3% of clinical decisions, and cost about seven dollars in API budget to build.

sources.title: Distilling hamo-score-0.6b: A Plateau, Three Bugs, and Why Data Beat ...
sources.snippet: The companion methodology notes to our open-weights release. How a 0.6B model learned to score psychological state from a cloud API's judgments — the three-stage teaching chain, the privacy rule that shaped every decision, a plateau that more data would not shift, and the diagnosis that broke it. A model three times larger gained one point. A data audit plus a one-line config fix gained three.
